nphi.title: India–Netherlands Strategic Partnership roadmap 2026–2030 (health chapter)

nphi.summary: Government roadmap with health cooperation on cross-border infectious diseases, AMR, vector-borne diseases, One Health, surveillance, digital health and climate and health, plus pharmaceuticals and medical devices for resilient supply…

nphi.title: WHO CC on behavioural science for emergency preparedness: partnerships with Slovenia, Spain and Ireland
nphi.with: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ); Instituto de Salud Carlos III (ISCIII); Department of Health, Ireland
nphi.summary: RIVM's WHO Collaborating Centre on behavioural science for emergency preparedness is working with public health bodies in Slovenia, Spain and Ireland. The partners use an RIVM-designed survey (e.g. Slovenia's twice-yearly SI-PANDA survey)…

nphi.title: RIVM – ICMR letter of intent
nphi.with: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)
nphi.summary: Five-year letter of intent (following an MoU of June 2025) on climate change and health, infectious diseases including AMR, vector-borne diseases, One Health and surveillance, with joint projects and capacity building.

nphi.title: LASR – Long-acting spatial repellents vs indoor residual spraying against malaria in western Kenya
nphi.with: Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI, scientific lead); US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (partner); Radboudumc; ITM Antwerp
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 cluster-randomised trial in western Kenya comparing a spatial repellent with indoor residual spraying, led scientifically by KEMRI with US CDC as partner.

nphi.title: GHPP Egypt – GMP training for the Egyptian Drug Authority
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: Egyptian Drug Authority (EDA); Biotech Training Facility (Leiden)
nphi.summary: Basic and advanced Good Manufacturing Practice training for EDA staff: quality systems, risk management, deviations and CAPA, data integrity and inspection preparedness.

nphi.title: Kenya–Netherlands climate and health partnership
nphi.with: National Public Health Institute of Kenya; Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI); TNO; Kenyan Ministry of Health; Dutch Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport
nphi.summary: Bilateral health-ministry partnership in which RIVM and Kenya's NPHI work on a climate change and health vulnerability and adaptation assessment. It also covers guidelines for green, climate-resilient healthcare facilities and knowledge…

nphi.title: EpiGen Ethiopia – Building scalable pathogen genomic epidemiology for Ethiopia
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI); Armauer Hansen Research Institute; Ethiopian Ministry of Health; Arsi, Jimma, Bahir Dar and Hawassa universities; St Paul's Millennium Medical College; Heinrich-Heine-Universität Düsseldorf; ISGlobal; PharmAccess; Africa CDC (core partner)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project building a national genomics-based surveillance system in Ethiopia, with EPHI and AHRI as national sequencing centres linked to 30 IDSR sites and a shared data platform.

nphi.title: DURABLE – large-scale emerging-disease project (EU4Health)
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur (coordinator); RIVM; ISS; INSA; Croatian Institute of Public Health; BIOR; Charité; FLI
nphi.summary: EU4Health project led by Institut Pasteur with national public health institutes across 15 countries on emerging disease preparedness.

nphi.title: GHPP China – green hospitals and efficient medicine use
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: Chinese health authorities (not named on the source page)
nphi.summary: Government-to-government partnership on efficient use of medicines, energy-efficient hospitals and switching from polluting anaesthetic gases to intravenous anaesthesia.

nphi.title: GHPP Colombia – WHO Tricycle AMR surveillance
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: Colombian partners (not named on the source page)
nphi.summary: Implements the WHO Tricycle protocol to measure antimicrobial resistance (ESBL E. coli) across humans, animals and the environment, to detect AMR faster; also relevant for the Caribbean Netherlands.

nphi.title: GHPP Indonesia – vaccine infrastructure and local production
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: Indonesian Ministry of Health and partners (not named on the source page)
nphi.summary: Supports local production of medicines and vaccines in Indonesia, with training in biotechnology and medicine production.

nphi.title: GHPP South Africa – wastewater-based disease detection
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: South African partners (not named on the source page)
nphi.summary: Early detection of disease through wastewater analysis (including SARS-CoV-2) to spot health risks sooner.

nphi.title: GHPP India – sustainable pharmaceutical production and supply chains
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: Indian partners (not named on the source page)
nphi.summary: Cooperation on sustainable pharmaceutical production, availability of medical products through supply chains, and a more robust health system.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P99 – Strengthening biosafety and biosecurity capabilities in East and Central Africa
nphi.with: Expertise France; SCJS Europe; University of Liège; ISEM Institute
nphi.summary: RIVM leads the national biorisk assessment and biorisk-management work packages and co-leads dual-use research oversight in a One Health biosecurity project.

nphi.title: MPX-RESPONSE – Clinical research network to improve the management of mpox

nphi.title: Africa CDC – Global Health EDCTP3 renewed MoU and Joint Action Plan 2025–2027
nphi.with: Global Health EDCTP3
nphi.summary: Renewed MoU (building on 2021) on workforce, clinical trial systems, research and local manufacturing.

nphi.summary: Network of 42 European NPHIs holding annual meetings (supported by IANPHI since 2006) on health security, climate, data and the future role of NPHIs.

nphi.title: TRIuMPH – upscaling the WHO TRIcycle protocol for One Health CPE surveillance

nphi.summary: RIVM coordinates One Health AMR work in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, covering stewardship, infection prevention and a surveillance pilot.

nphi.summary: FHI hosted European NPHIs on their role in health security preparedness, medical countermeasures and resilience amid funding shifts and misinformation.

nphi.title: National Inventory of Dangerous Pathogens in Sri Lanka

nphi.title: CLIMOS – Climate monitoring and decision support for sand fly-borne diseases

nphi.title: BE READY – European Research Partnership for pandemic preparedness (CSA)

nphi.title: EU Twinning: Strengthening Blood Safety System in Georgia

nphi.title: Fiocruz – Erasmus MC and EATRIS MoUs
nphi.with: Erasmus University Medical Center; EATRIS
nphi.summary: International cooperation MoUs between Fiocruz and Erasmus MC (2020-2025) and the European translational medicine infrastructure EATRIS (2020-2023).

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P73 – CBRN protection of critical civil infrastructure

nphi.summary: RIVM assessed risks to Jordan's water infrastructure and delivered COVID-19 support (training, e-learning, NGS course, equipment) in Lebanon, Iraq and Jordan.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P81 – Strengthening biosecurity and response capacities in Southeast Asia

nphi.summary: In 2017, a Pakistani NIH and ministry delegation spent a week at RIVM with IANPHI, PHE and US CDC. Together they drafted a vision, a mission and an action plan for turning NIH into a comprehensive NPHI.

nphi.title: EACCR2 – Eastern Africa Consortium for Clinical Research 2

nphi.summary: EDCTP2 regional network of excellence coordinated by Uganda's national health research organisation to strengthen clinical trial and research capacity across Eastern Africa. Tanzania's NIMR and KEMRI were partners alongside European…

nphi.title: ESPrIT – Strengthening the occupational health expertise and scientific capacity of the Public Health Institution of Turkey
nphi.with: Public Health Institution of Turkey (Ministry of Health); Ghent University; Amsterdam UMC
nphi.summary: Horizon 2020 Twinning that used training, mentoring and staff exchanges to build PHIT's research capacity on occupational diseases and national data collection.

nphi.title: ZikaPLAN – Zika Preparedness Latin American Network

nphi.title: ZIKAlliance – A global alliance for Zika virus control and prevention

nphi.title: RIVM–Indonesia partnership on AMR and One Health
nphi.with: Indonesian Ministry of Health and government delegation
nphi.summary: RIVM partnered with Indonesia on antimicrobial resistance and One Health from 2016, also discussing climate, air quality and waste, and hosted an Indonesian ministerial delegation in 2019.

nphi.title: RIVM support to the Caribbean countries of the Kingdom (IHR Kingdom Agreement)

nphi.title: EU Twinning: strengthening control of health and environmental risks (ANCSEP, Tunisia)

nphi.with: Agence Nationale de Contrôle Sanitaire et Environnemental des Produits (ANCSEP)
nphi.summary: EUR 1 million EU Twinning (Sept 2015–Sept 2017) under the PACS programme helping Tunisia's ANCSEP improve health and environmental risk assessment and management, including legislative alignment.

nphi.title: Biosecurity and national dangerous-pathogen inventories in East Africa (incl. lessons learned)

nphi.title: Source to Tap and Back (S2TAB), Ethiopia

nphi.summary: RIVM worked on climate-resilient water safety plans and water-quality monitoring at utilities in Addis Ababa and Adama and at EPHI's laboratory.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P15 – Laboratory iso-bank system for biosecurity and biosafety
nphi.with: Erasmus University; TNO
nphi.summary: RIVM led the project, which assessed biorisk management and built a database linking laboratories and hospital information systems in three Southeast Asian countries.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 03 – Knowledge development and transfer of best practice on biosafety/biosecurity/biorisk management

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P44 – CBRN preparedness and response enhancement in South East and Eastern Europe
nphi.with: SCK CEN (Belgium); ISEM Institute; IRE-ELiT
nphi.summary: RIVM led the work package that produced a country report for each of the nine partner countries, plus train-the-trainer materials and exercise guidance, to strengthen how first responders handle CBRN incidents.

nphi.title: COACTION – AMR cooperation Colombia–Netherlands

nphi.summary: Mapped antibiotic use and resistance actors in Colombia, compared them with the Dutch approach, and explored ways the two countries could cooperate on AMR policy.

nphi.title: National Inventory of Dangerous Pathogens in North Africa
nphi.with: CRDF Global (US State Dept ISN/CTR funding)
nphi.summary: As a CRDF Global subcontractor, RIVM adapted its Uganda pathogen-inventory software and method, then held consultations with Jordan and Tunisia.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P53 – Strengthening biosafety and biosecurity in Central Asia

nphi.summary: RIVM led the biosecurity training and supported the biosafety training, including hands-on BSL3 work, for national expert teams in seven countries.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P57 – CBRN crime scene forensics in South East and Eastern Europe
nphi.with: SCK CEN (coordinator); Netherlands Forensic Institute; INCC Belgium; Forensic Science Centre Ivan Vučetić; ISEMI
nphi.summary: RIVM led the project, which trained forensic investigators to collect evidence at CBRN incident scenes, wrote procedures, and ran six sub-regional exercises.

nphi.title: CAESAR – Central Asian and European Surveillance of Antimicrobial Resistance
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe; ESCMID
nphi.summary: RIVM gives technical support (data management, quality control, analysis) to the WHO Europe AMR surveillance network for non-EU countries in Central Asia and Eastern Europe.

nphi.title: ENABLE Consortium – digital health for maternal and child health

nphi.summary: 12-partner consortium coordinated by NIPH working with Ethiopian and Nigerian institutions on digital health for maternal and child health.
